lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A regular grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in at least four vertical columns and three horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersecting horizontal rows of spots to form a distinct checkerboard-like lattice on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges characterized by a light-to-shadow vertical gradient running longitudinally across the upper flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of approximately 4-6 low-contrast high-luminance spots visible within the dark silhouette of the first dorsal fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced V-shaped indentation or notch on the posterior trailing edge of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: High-frequency clustering of smaller-diameter spots on the head and pectoral fin surfaces relative to the larger, sparser spots on the lateral flank.
